fields.label: Product Name
fields.description: The whitelabel umbrella brand shown on the dark hero panel (e.g. Vodafone, Vodafone X).

fields.label: Business / Store Name
fields.description: The specific tenant, e.g. 'Glow Salon & Spa'. Shown next to the logo on the form panel. Leave blank to fall back to Product Name.

fields.label: Business Logo
fields.description: Shown on the form panel above the sign-in heading. Square or wide logos both work — recommended height 40-56px.

fields.label: Primary Color
fields.description: The brand color — red across every tenant by design. Drives the hero panel, buttons and focus states. Don't change the hue per business; adjust only if your exact brand guideline gives a different red/hex.

fields.label: Accent Color
fields.description: A deeper red for the status dot and small highlights — stays in the same red family as Primary Color, never a different hue.

fields.label: Custom Footer Text
fields.description: Optional — e.g. support hours, a legal line.
